grades: Current Texas high school sophomores and juniors
name: DYNAMC (Discover Yourself In Accounting Majors and Careers)
org: McCombs School of Business, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: Learn about jobs you can get with an accounting degree. There are sessions, networking and mentoring. Sponsored by Ernst & Young Global Limited.
who_can_apply: Current Texas high school sophomores and juniors. Students who are in summer school on the program dates cannot take part. Chosen students usually have a strong school record and personal wins.
pay_detail: Free. The page says educational, food and boarding costs are covered. Students pay their own travel to and from campus.
duration: June 20 to 25, 2027 on the UT Austin campus, with on campus living
deadline_text: The page says applications are closed now. It also says the 2027 application opens Nov 1. It lists a deadline of Feb 1, 2027 (supplemental materials Feb 8, 2027). Confirm with McCombs.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. You need your school record, your activities, essays, a letter and a resume. Email SummerPrograms@mccombs.utexas.edu or call 512-475-7340.
notes: Texas high school students only. Shared McCombs page for three programs. Decisions are released by mid April.
